verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration-filing SaaS, so a documented public API is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence describes only guided intake flows, eligibility checkers, fee calculators and attorney-reviewed workflows, with no API documentation. Probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at every candidate path, and for llms.txt, all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
